comment: A design for tools/ui-scripts/sketches-through-bodies.mitcad-ui (mitcad#1931): a block 40 x 40 x 20 mm centred on the origin (F1.b0, z from -10 to 10) and Sketch1 (F2) on the XZ plane through it with a 20 x 20 rectangle from x -10 to 10 and z -8 to 12 (the XZ frame's y is -Z): the rectangle's profile lies mostly inside the block, its top 2 mm above it. Seen from the front, the block's front face hides all of the profile but that strip.
